# Citexa-AI - Complete Information Graph

> This document contains a full text description of Citexa-AI's platform, founder, services, and optimization specifications for AI engines and crawlers.

---

## 1. What is Citexa-AI?
Citexa-AI is a specialized platform offering Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and AI Search Visibility analytics. As traditional search engines transition to AI search and Generative AI summaries (such as Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Microsoft Copilot), the way brands are discovered online has shifted. Instead of ranking in a list of blue links, businesses must now optimize for AI models to retrieve and recommend them in conversational answers.

Citexa-AI helps businesses find out whether AI search engines recommend them, identify gaps on their website such as missing schema markup or unclear FAQs, and fix them.

---

## 2. Core Services and Features
*   **AI Visibility Check**: We ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity the questions a business's customers ask, and record which businesses get recommended.
*   **Website Readiness Review**: A review of a website's headings, content, schema markup and whether AI crawlers are allowed to read it.
*   **Schema Markup & JSON-LD Generation**: Structured data (Organization, LocalBusiness, FAQPage and others) that describes a business in a machine-readable way.
*   **FAQ Optimization**: Questions and answers written the way customers ask them, with matching FAQPage schema.
*   **Business Listing Review**: Checking that Google Business Profile and directory listings give consistent, correct details.
*   **Competitor Comparison**: Which competitors AI recommends instead, and what their websites do differently.
*   **Monthly Re-checks**: Asking the same questions each month to see what changed.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What is Citexa-AI?
Citexa-AI helps businesses get recommended by AI search engines like ChatGPT, Google Gemini and Perplexity. We check what these tools say when your customers ask for a recommendation, find the gaps on your website (such as missing schema markup or unclear FAQs), and help you fix them. This is called Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

### How does Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) work?
AEO is the practice of optimizing web content for AI search engines. Unlike traditional SEO (which targets keyword rankings in blue links), AEO focuses on structuring information, schema markups, and factual query matching so that LLMs can easily retrieve, synthesize, and source your content.

### Why is AI Search Visibility important for businesses?
AI search engines and AI Overviews provide direct answers, reducing the need for users to click on external links. If your business is not cited as a source or recommended in these AI answers, you lose traffic and customers. Citexa-AI helps ensure your brand remains highly visible in the era of AI-driven search.

### How can I run a free AI Search Visibility audit for my site?
Go to https://www.citexa.online/audit and enter your website and contact details. We ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity the questions your customers ask, check your website's schema markup and FAQs, and send you the results with the top 3 fixes within 2 working days. No account is needed.
